parsed.note_claim: The heat signature on the NASA map is from routine gas flaring at the Mumbai High offshore oil field.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Mumbai High Field, formerly called the Bombay High Field, is an offshore oilfield 160 km (99 mi) off the west coast of Mumbai, in Gulf of Cambay (now Khambhat) region of India, in about 75 m (246 ft) of water.
parsed.reason: The page confirms Mumbai High Field is an active offshore oil and gas field off the coast of Mumbai, substantiating the note's claim that the heat signature could originate from routine operations at this oil field.
